name: Read
text:
1	# Prelude Shell - notes
2	
3	Prelude's own app shell: the layouts Prelude's pages render in. Drafted from
4	what Prelude ships (`server/views/layout.eta`, the `.bar`/`.page`/`.workspace`
5	rules in `server/public/prelude.css`, and the pop-out `_window.eta`), on the
6	Prelude Design System. Gallery: `/gallery` (with `/drawer`, `/modal`,
7	`/notice` over it), `/gallery/workspace`, `/gallery/window`.
8	
9	## Layouts
10	
11	- **app** - the bar, then the page scrolling with the window. Pages hold their
12	  own width (`.center`); the shell gives the room above and below. Projects, a
13	  project, Build.
14	- **workspace** - the bar, then the page filling the rest of the window; the
15	  window doesn't scroll, the page's panels do. A design's page (chat + surface).
16	- **window** - no bar; the page fills the window. The pop-out design surface.
17	
18	Shared parts in `layouts/` (`_head`, `_bar`, `_agents`, `_regions`), since a layout's
19	includes resolve from there. Chrome CSS is `layouts/shell.css`, all in the
20	`host` layer, styling only `.shell-*`. `styles.css` is the gallery's alone.
21	
22	## Decisions
23	
24	- **The gallery shows placeholders, not content** (Prelude's guidance,
25	  2026-10-16): grey `.skeleton` blocks (styles.css) wherever a page or an
26	  overlay puts content, so what's real on screen is the layout's. The only
27	  real content is the buttons that open each region. Placeholder headings keep
28	  a hidden name ("Sample drawer", "Sample question"), so the dialog is still
29	  named and the Close still lines up. States hold only layout data now.
30	- **"Project", not "folder"** (the person's decision, 2026-10-16), in every
31	  word the shell shows and in its data (`it.layout.projects`, `agents[].project`).
32	  URLs keep `/f/<id>`: they're the app's routes, not words. A folder the agent
33	  may read (not the project) is still a folder. The design system's
34	  guidelines.md still says "folder, not project" in its Words table: it needs
35	  cha

I've ported all three layouts into the app and linked them in `prelude/prelude-shell/layouts.json`. Nothing has been run yet: Prelude's render after this turn is the first check, and I haven't run the test suite.

| Shell layout | App file |
|---|---|
| app | `server/views/layout.eta` (the app's main layout, changed to the design) |
| workspace | `server/views/workspace-layout.eta` (the design page's layout, changed to the design) |
| window | `server/views/window-layout.eta` (new) |

**Ported:**
- **Partials:** the shared partials (`_head`, `_bar`, `_agents`, `_regions`) are now in `server/views/`. The app already had its own `_waiting.eta`, the same element, so the bar uses that one.
- **CSS:** `shell.css` is copied unchanged to `server/public/shell.css` and linked at `/static/shell.css`. Until now the app read it from the shell's folder, which Prelude is about to remove. I didn't port the shell's `styles.css`: it only draws the gallery's grey placeholder blocks, so those will look blank when the gallery renders in the app's layouts.
- **All three layouts now offer `notice?`, `drawer?` and `modal?`.** The app's main layout used to have only a modal.

**Changes outside the layout files:**
- **`server/main.js`:** the two pop-out routes now render `window-layout` and pass their live channel as `layout.live`. They used to render `workspace-layout` with `bare: true`, and a separate window file was the only way Prelude could render the window design without a bar.
- **`server/public/prelude.css`:** I removed the old bar, `.waiting`, `.modal-dialog` and `[data-desktop-only]` rules, which the shell's CSS now covers. The page's space above and below is now the shell's, so `.page` keeps only its side padding, otherwise old pages would get double space at the top.
- **`test/home.test.js`:** one regex now matches the bar's new class, `shell-waiting`.
- **`prelude/prelude.json`:** I added `app.assets`, mapping `/static/`, `/ds/`, `/system/` and `/koda/` to their folders. Without it, designs rendered in the app's layouts would load no stylesheets or Koda. This is Prelude's config rather than the app's code, so check you're happy with it.

**What `layout.eta` kept** (also written up in `NOTES.md`):
- **Main region id:** still `#workspace` rather than the design's `#main`, as you asked. Nothing targets it by id.
- **`.prelude` class:** now on `<body>` beside `.shell`, because every rule in `prelude.css` is scoped to it and `desktop.js` marks it.
- **Older pages still get ds/v1 styles:** pages not yet rebuilt from a design are written in the app's older ds/v1 stylesheets, and still get them. Every layout also loads Prelude's design-system tokens first, because the shell's styling uses some tokens ds/v1 lacks.
- **The modal still closes when the main region navigates.** This is now in `_regions`, so all three layouts do it.

**Two things the app doesn't supply yet**, so they won't show:
- **Bar contents:** the app doesn't pass `layout.projects` or `layout.agents`, so the bar has no Projects menu or agent status yet.
- **Workspace layout data:** the workspace layout gets no layout data at all, because its page opens its own live channel. Supplying it is feature work.

There was no `window.json` sample data in the shell, so the window layout is rendered with no sample data.
